content:
teresa: opened PR to add an airgapped connection quickstart focused on kms-proxy + HSM. Please review the cert bundle steps, systemd override, and the SDK unix-socket examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1422

mike: skimmed. two quick things: show both standard PKCS#11 socket locations and a fallback for distros that place sockets under /var/lib. also include a short note about sticky permissions when sockets are recreated by the HSM service.

anil: added a tiny cert bundle example and a note about client certs staying in the HSM while cert files are served from disk. snippet:```bash
# create combined bundle for kms-proxy
cat root.pem int.pem client.pem > /etc/redwood/certs/kms-bundle.pem
chown kms:kms /etc/redwood/certs/kms-bundle.pem
chmod 640 /etc/redwood/certs/kms-bundle.pem
```

kevin: For systemd, prefer documenting a drop-in instead of replacing the unit. Example to show:```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/kms-proxy.service.d/10-local.conf
[Service]
Environment=KMS_CONFIG=/etc/redwood/kms-proxy.yaml
Restart=on-failure
LimitNOFILE=65536
User=kms
```
Then `sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl enable --now kms-proxy`. Add troubleshooting tips: `journalctl -u kms-proxy -f` and `ss -xl | grep pkcs11` to verify unix sockets.

mike: suggest adding a small ACL example so the kms user can access the HSM socket when the HSM runs as root: `setfacl -m u:kms:rw /var/run/hsm/pkcs11.sock`. Also show both `/var/run/hsm/pkcs11.sock` and `/var/lib/hsm/pkcs11.sock` in PKCS#11 examples.

anil: SDK snippets updated. Python example uses pathlib to avoid double-slash issues:```py
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('/var/run/hsm/pkcs11.sock')
client = KMSClient(endpoint=f'unix://{path.as_posix()}')
```
Go example updated to avoid InsecureSkipVerify and read TLS endpoint from env:```go
creds := credentials.NewTLS(&tls.Config{InsecureSkipVerify: false})
conn, err := grpc.Dial(os.Getenv("KMS_ENDPOINT"), grpc.WithTransportCredentials(creds))
```
Add env examples: `export KMS_ENDPOINT=unix:///var/run/hsm/pkcs11.sock` and `export KMS_ENDPOINT=tls://kms.example:443`.

kevin: tiny accessibility nit: update alt text for the offline topology SVG to include "HSM and kms-proxy topology". Also reference the asset as `../assets/diagrams/offline-topo.svg` so the docs build resolves it.

docs-bot: lint: link-check OK, spelling: 1 warning ("priviledged" -> "privileged"), broken-anchor: 0. CI preview: https://deploy-preview-1422--docs.redwood.ai/private-airgap-conn-quickstart

mike: lgtm on content and ACL examples. kevin, can you squash the SVG commit into the PR?

kevin: will squash and push. merging in ~10m if no one objects. thanks everyone :rocket:
